statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-28755 lets a TLS handshake in the nginx stream module succeed even after an OCSP check rejected the client certificate, when ssl_verify_client and ssl_ocsp are on. nginx.org lists 1.27.2 to 1.29.6 as vulnerable and fixes it in 1.28.3 and 1.29.7 (https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html, https://my.f5.com/manage/s/article/K000160368); the fix is https://github.com/nginx/nginx/commit/78f581487706f2e43eea5a060c516fc4d98090e8. Every nginx-mainline package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI repository (1.28.2-r0 and 1.29.5-r0 to 1.29.8-r7 on x86_64 and aarch64, and 1.29.4-r0 on aarch64) contains no files and only depends on the nginx package of the same version, so it carries no nginx code of its own. That nginx owner is fixed from 1.28.3-r0 on its 1.28 line and from 1.29.7-r0 on its 1.29 line. Pending: whether this owner should be recorded as not containing the component, or should follow the nginx package it depends on, which would make it fixed from 1.29.7-r0.

CVE-2026-28755 lets a TLS handshake in the nginx stream module succeed even after an OCSP check rejected the client certificate, when ssl_verify_client and ssl_ocsp are on. nginx.org lists 1.27.2 to 1.29.6 as vulnerable and fixes it in 1.28.3 and 1.29.7 (https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html, https://my.f5.com/manage/s/article/K000160368); the fix is https://github.com/nginx/nginx/commit/78f581487706f2e43eea5a060c516fc4d98090e8. For Alpine 3.23, the DHI repository publishes nginx builds from two upstream lines under one package name. The builds 1.28.0-r8, 1.28.1-r0 (aarch64 only), 1.28.2-r0 and 1.28.2-r1 ship releases before 1.28.3, and 1.29.4-r0 (aarch64 only), 1.29.5-r0, 1.29.5-r1 and 1.29.6-r1 ship mainline releases before 1.29.7, all without a backport of the fix. Every 1.28.3 build (1.28.3-r0 to 1.28.3-r7 and 1.28.3-r9) and every 1.29.7 and 1.29.8 build (1.29.7-r0 to 1.29.8-r7) ships a fixed release, as each nginx binary's version banner shows on x86_64 and aarch64. The 1.29 builds sort above the 1.28.3 fix, so the range reopens at 1.29.0 and closes again at 1.29.7-r0.
